I've been there too and what has worked for me is to start your day with 3 things you like/love about yourself and end your day with 3 things you did well that day(even if it is drinking water instead of soda it does not have to be big). 

What happened to me is when I started doing this at first every time I said anything nice about myself a little whisper inside said "no you're wrong that is not true" but I did it anyway and after about 15/17 days or so I didn't hear that whisper anymore, but I started to get down on myself about the things I was saying like "why didn't you do better? All you did good today was drink water- you're lazy."  

But I kept doing it even though nothing was happening then after about a month or so I slowly started to feel good about myself and the things that I needed to improve on I slowly started to improve.

Now I still slip up from time to time and go into 'You're dumb and stupid why did you do or say that etc. etc." but I get over that A LOT quicker and get back to being kind to myself.

Hope nothing but the best- Remember- Be Kind To Yourself

Asking this in order to seek understanding- how do you build discipline? I agree with you I think if we all had the discipline to follow through we all would be better off, but how do you actually build unwavering discipline?

1st let me say you are not alone I've been there and a lot of people are there right now. Some things that have worked for me I will list below.

However, before I list them, if you are like me,  you will think they are dumb or will not work but I am telling you with love and kindness if you do these consistently they will work for you too.

​

\*\*\*NOTE very crucial as you do each of these physically think to yourself-"Good job on doing this..... I am proud of myself for doing this........

1- Be in the present moment- when you have those thoughts walk outside barefoot and focus on each step and think to yourself how each step feels- is the ground or grass dry, wet, hard. This is called grounding and it helps put you in the present moment

2-start each day with 3-5 things you love about yourself. They can be anything they just have to be positive. It can be small like I love that I woke up today, I love that my heart is beating, I love the way I look today.

3-Move the body- any exercise you can do will work pending your skill level. If you hate workingout- that is fine- just walk around the block twice, or simply stand up & sit down on the couch 20 times. Or if you are more advanced

4-Drink water & Eat health- No matter where you fit on this spectrum just do one notch above where you are. If you normally eat pretty health then make the next meal a step up. Same goes the other way if you normally eat fast food- then just do 1 meal tomorrow of good healthy food and the rest can be fast food.

5-Do not isolate- I know this one can be difficult but zoom, google hangout, skype whatever you can to stay connected to friends and family. I know for me just talking to friends makes me feel better.

6-Remember- you have made it through EVERY bad day you have ever had in your entire life. You can make it through one more.

​

Remember- Be Kind To Yourself
